**Sol 1.1: all the 1.1 updates in one place (builds 36 to 68).**

- Pounds everywhere, exact cash, bulk buy (x1, x10, x100, Max).
- Milestones, synergies, critical taps and golden sun buffs.
- Crypto mining with miners you can see, real coin names and logos.
- Head office upgrades, stats, sound, number format.
- Rebirth and the RBP tree, with new companies, estates and a collection.
- Sol Casino (a tree unlock): slots, Sun Forge, roulette and blackjack.
- Hourly dividends, sell a company, manager switch, centred pop-ups.

Older 1.1 builds were folded into this one. Install the newest release instead.
